proofs.text: Set a project up through init with no spec written and verify the shim exits 0 printing no `purlin:` line; delete `.purlin/` and run `scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh` directly, verifying exit 0 with empty stdout; run the same script in a directory that is not a git repository, with the repository search stopped above it, and verify exit 0 with empty stdout. Run every one of these through the plainest POSIX shell the host has, dash where there is one, since `sh` is bash under another name on some hosts and takes extensions dash rejects; and verify the script's first line asks for `/bin/sh` and its only `set` line is `set -u`

rule_text: The hook exits 0 and prints nothing when there is no project to check: no specs, no `.purlin/`, or no git repository

tests.body:
def test_a_project_with_no_specs_exits_zero(self):
        made = Project(specs=False)
        try:
            done = made.push()
            assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
            assert 'purlin:' not in done.stdout
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_project_that_is_not_a_purlin_project_exits_zero
